## Behavioral change

Describe the observable contract changed by this pull request.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover the behavior or the omission is explained.
- [ ] Documentation matches changed commands, configuration, or workflow.
- [ ] Compatibility and migration impact are stated.

## Release impact
